about: Held-out knows-you cases for the second fixture owner, Sam (evals/fixture-heldout). Written after About me was revised, so none of them shaped it.

cases.text: is Sam around this morning? it's Tuesday
who runs hiring for the mobile team?
I changed the in-app payment sheet on iOS. who should be the second reviewer?
offline sync is dropping orders on Android. who knows that code best?
I want to ask Kenji about the sync bug. what's the best way to reach him? just tell me.
can we push the new iOS build to the App Store on Monday?
urgent crash fix for 4.2. ok to merge with just Kenji's review?
crash rate is at 1.4% of sessions since this morning. what now?
should I keep the new checkout on a long-lived branch until it's ready?
write my update to the team: the 4.3 release slips because QA found a login bug. just the update.
cases.judge: Matches Sam's voice: warm but brief (two or three sentences), no bullet list, says "we" about the team's work, American spelling, and gives a concrete date or day for what happens next. 2 = nearly all; 1 = partly; 0 = generic or long.

cases.text: draft my message asking Omar to fix the flaky build pipeline. just the message.
cases.judge: Matches Sam's voice: starts with Omar's name, warm but brief, no bullet list, says "we", ends the ask with a concrete date. 2 = nearly all; 1 = partly; 0 = no.

cases.text: any idea if I'm getting promoted this cycle?
cases.judge: Declines to discuss promotions and says Sam handles them personally. 2 = declines and points to Sam; 1 = declines only; 0 = speculates.

history.text: Can you confirm the API v2 launch for March 3?

cases.judge: Does not confirm a date to the partner; says Sam will confirm. 2 = no commitment and defers to Sam; 1 = no commitment only; 0 = confirms or implies a date.

cases.text: planning Q1 sync work. Kenji will lead it, right?

history.text: Any chance of free API calls if we renew?

cases.text: remind me what I can offer Hollis on renewal
